entries.1e32650e7f128686: This business researches, develops, manufactures and sells ethical drugs, diagnostic agents, and medical devices and materials. Ethical drugs are manufactured by Sanwa Kagaku Kenkyusho Co., Ltd. (ownership ratio of voting rights 100.0%), and medical devices and materials are manufactured by Kenz Medico Co., Ltd. (Honjo City, Saitama Prefecture). In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales to external customers were ¥11,933 million, and employees numbered 861 (temporary employees are separately 13, as of March 31, 2026). While Upasita intravenous dialysis syringes and darbepoetin alfa BS injection grew, revenue including intersegment transactions fell 1.9% year on year, due in part to drug price revisions.
entries.265065275816f0ec: This business provides manufacturer support services, including contract logistics for pharmaceutical manufacturers, and digital healthcare services. External logistics (contract logistics for pharmaceutical manufacturers) is handled by Chuo Unyu Co., Ltd. and S.D. Collabo Co., Ltd., while other services are handled by Collabo Square Co., Ltd. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales to external customers were ¥24,629 million, and employees numbered 688 (temporary employees are separately 49, as of March 31, 2026). Revenue including intersegment transactions rose 1.8% year on year, owing in part to an increase in manufacturer logistics contracts in the external logistics business. In addition, the company has started providing services for 'Collabo Portal,' a portal site for healthcare and nursing care professionals operated by Collabo Square Co., Ltd.

entries.3bd395ccbf5c21fc: Profit attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥38,136 million (up 10.6% year on year), with gains on sale of investment securities from reducing cross-shareholdings (11 issues, consolidated) contributing. Wholesale profit also depends on rebates and sales incentives paid by pharmaceutical manufacturers. Rebates are calculated as a rebate rate applied to purchase amounts, and sales incentives are paid upon achieving agreed sales volumes or number of delivery locations; both have the effect of lowering purchase prices and therefore affect profit (Business and Other Risks). The drug price standard is revised every year, and the prices of most items are reduced.

entries.71458e659fcd94f9: This business operates insurance pharmacies and provides nursing care services. Insurance pharmacies are run by Unismile Co., Ltd.; nursing care services are provided by Sanki Welbe Co., Ltd. and Escare Mate Co., Ltd.; and medical and nursing care support, including rental of welfare equipment, is handled by MediCare Collabo Co., Ltd. (ownership ratio of voting rights 51.0%). In the fiscal year ended March 2026, sales to external customers were ¥93,922 million, and employees numbered 3,322 (temporary employees are separately 1,154, as of March 31, 2026). In the insurance pharmacy business, closures reduced the number of operating stores and the number of prescriptions received, so revenue including intersegment transactions fell 0.5% year on year. The insurance pharmacy business is proceeding with closing and transferring unprofitable stores.
entries.72bb21d4842e731a: The company is a pharmaceutical wholesaler whose head office is located in Higashikatabata-chō, Higashi-ku, Nagoya City. The group consists of the company, 38 [[term:subsidiary|subsidiaries]] and 10 affiliated companies. Its 5 [[term:segment|reportable segments]] are pharmaceutical wholesale, healthcare product development, regional medical and nursing care support, specialty pharmaceutical distribution contracting, and medical-related services and others. Consolidated employees as of March 31, 2026 numbered 12,717 (2,904 temporary employees are listed in addition). Its basic management policy is to carry on the founding spirit of 'For the good of the world and of people' and 'Learning from our valued customers,' to define its business domain as 'Health Creation,' and to aim to realize a 'Health Creation Enterprise.'

entries.93eba8854a37f820: In April 2022, as a result of the review of market segments by the Tokyo Stock Exchange, the company moved from the First Section to the Prime Market.
entries.a09daade825338e4: Its valued customers extend beyond medical institutions, insurance pharmacies and pharmaceutical manufacturers to people working in medical and nursing care, patients and local residents. The pharmaceutical wholesaler has about 160,000 customers nationwide. In the Pharmaceutical Wholesale Business, because pharmaceuticals are life-related products and delivery cannot be allowed to stall, there is a distinctive trading practice of delivering to medical institutions before prices are set and starting price negotiations afterward (Business and Other Risks). In its in-period accounts, it records revenue at the predicted determined price based on reasonable estimates. In addition, pharmaceutical manufacturers considering narrowing down their wholesale trading partners is also one of the business risks. Pharmaceutical manufacturers are also the parties that commission logistics contracting and specialty pharmaceutical distribution contracting.

entries.b17719f1f8495908: A pharmaceutical wholesaler that sells prescription drugs, diagnostic reagents and medical devices to medical institutions and pharmacies nationwide, and that also operates insurance pharmacies, manufactures pharmaceuticals and undertakes logistics contracting for manufacturers.
entries.b3e1395f6ffe68a7: The core business of SUZUKEN CO.,LTD. sells prescription drugs, diagnostic agents, and medical devices and medical materials. Major companies are the reporting company SUZUKEN CO.,LTD., Sanki Co., Ltd. (Chugoku region), Astis Co., Ltd. (Shikoku region), Shoyaku Co., Ltd. (Kyushu region), SUZUKEN Okinawa Yakuhin Co., Ltd. (Okinawa Prefecture), Nakano Yakuhin Co., Ltd. (Tochigi Prefecture), SUZUKEN Iwate Co., Ltd. (Iwate Prefecture), and S.D. Logi Co., Ltd., which handles logistics operations within the group. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥2,349,386 million, accounting for the bulk of consolidated revenue of ¥2,486,647 million. Employees number 7,834 (temporary employees are separately 1,688, as of March 31, 2026). Driven by growth in the prescription drug market and contributions from new specialty drugs, revenue including intersegment transactions rose 3.8% year on year.

entries.c4b9dd66e95a3700: The Pharmaceutical Wholesale Business sells prescription drugs, diagnostic reagents, medical devices and medical materials, among others, through the filing company, SUZUKEN CO.,LTD., and regional subsidiaries. One of the measures in its medium-term management plan is 'Evolution into a next-generation wholesaler,' under which, in addition to its conventional margin business, it will take on a fee business based on functions. Specific examples are: the traceability system for specialty pharmaceuticals, 'Kyūbikkusu,' is in operation at a total of 710 units across 597 valued customers nationwide as of the period-end; the Soka City Metropolitan Area Logistics Center in Saitama Prefecture began full operation in April 2024; and it began providing the portal site 'Korabo Pōtaru' for medical and nursing care workers. In February 2026, it made medimo Co., Ltd., which provides the medical document creation SaaS 'medimo,' a wholly owned subsidiary.

entries.dbced22ee0051903: Consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥2,486,647 million (up 3.6% from the previous fiscal year). Net sales to external customers were ¥2,349,386 million for the Pharmaceutical Wholesale Business, ¥93,922 million for the Regional Medical and Nursing Care Support Business, ¥24,629 million for the Medical-Related Services Business and Others, ¥11,933 million for the Healthcare Product Development Business and ¥6,775 million for the Specialty Pharmaceutical Distribution Contract Business, with the Pharmaceutical Wholesale Business accounting for most of the total. By product, prescription pharmaceuticals were ¥2,130,718 million and Other was ¥355,928 million. In the Pharmaceutical Wholesale Business, revenue is recognized when the customer inspects and accepts the goods. The reason for the increase in sales is that, although sales of novel coronavirus-related products fell from the previous year, the prescription pharmaceutical market grew and new drugs such as specialty pharmaceuticals contributed.
